cluster_order: Sorted lineage IDs; all domain-selected descendants together; strata attack then benign
mixed_label_cluster: Reject stratification that splits a lineage
paired_delta: B minus A on identical resampling indices
point_estimate: Observed frozen core metric, never bootstrap mean
resampling_storage: Indices only; never duplicate canonical sample IDs
stream_policy: Default resets PCG64(seed); explicit shared PCG64 allowed only with recorded pre/post state hashes
undefined_policy: Exclude undefined replicates; null CI if observed undefined or support below 95%
